transfer_gate_lemmas.pointwise_short_interval_to_row_run: A pointwise theorem giving a prime in every interval of length x^theta at x~P^2 only gives no empty row-run longer than P^(2theta-1+o(1)); every-row closure requires theta<=1/2.
transfer_gate_lemmas.linnik_to_square_column: A least-prime-in-AP theorem p(a mod P) << P^L enters the P^2 square only if L<=2 with compatible constants and reduced residue classes.
transfer_gate_lemmas.almost_all_exceptional_to_lattice: Almost-all x short-interval PNT does not control the rigid lattice of P-spaced row starts without an additional grid-transfer or second-moment input.
transfer_gate_lemmas.mean_value_ap_to_fixed_prime_modulus: Bombieri-Vinogradov/Elliott-Halberstam style mean-value distribution, even beyond x^1/2, does not imply the fixed-modulus statement for q=P and all reduced residue classes without a zero-exception or fixed-prime-modulus transfer theorem.

source_version_snapshot.name: Baker-Harman-Pintz 2001
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Published pointwise prime in [x, x+x^0.525] for large x.

source_version_snapshot.name: Runbo Li short intervals
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Preprint claims primes in [x-x^0.52, x] for all sufficiently large x.

source_version_snapshot.name: Guth-Maynard large values
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Zero-density estimate and short-interval prime asymptotics at length x^(17/30+o(1)).

source_version_snapshot.name: Gafni-Tao exceptional intervals
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Exceptional-set interface: all x for theta>17/30 and almost all x for theta>2/15 are not row-grid pointwise closure.

source_version_snapshot.name: Le Duc Hieu short-interval prime APs
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Many k-term prime APs in every interval [x,x+x^theta] for theta>17/30; structurally stronger but length gate unchanged.

source_version_snapshot.name: Li-Zhang-Cai least P2 almost-prime in AP
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: P2(a,q) << q^1.8345, inside P^2 after q=P but wrong parity object.

source_version_snapshot.name: Stadlmann smooth-moduli prime AP distribution
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Average prime equidistribution to smooth moduli up to x^(1/2+1/40-epsilon); smooth-modulus average, not fixed prime modulus P.

source_version_snapshot.name: Runbo Li smooth-moduli minorant
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Minorant for prime indicator with level 10/19 in APs to smooth moduli; still not a fixed prime-modulus all-residue theorem.

source_version_snapshot.name: Pascadi weighted prime/smooth distribution
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Weighted/well-factorable prime distribution to moduli up to x^(5/8-o(1)); mean-value weighted input, not column closure.

source_version_snapshot.name: Runbo Li large-moduli Harman-sieve APs
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Mean-value theorems for primes to bilinear moduli up to x^(9/17) and trilinear moduli up to x^(17/32); almost-all q, not fixed q=P all residues.

source_version_snapshot.name: Bruna conditional least AP prime
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Assuming generalized Lindelof for Dirichlet L-functions, p(a mod q) <<_epsilon q^(2+epsilon); conditional and still outside a fixed q^2 square.

source_version_snapshot.name: Xylouris Linnik constant
source_version_snapshot.audited_payload: Least AP prime exponent L=5.2; later <5 records remain far above the needed L<=2 gate.

plain_conclusion: 外部前沿定理已经能给出真实副产品：Baker-Harman-Pintz 2001 禁止长度约 P^0.05 以上的连续空行串；若 Runbo Li 2025 预印本被接受，可把指数改进到 P^0.04。Xylouris/Meng 的 Linnik 型结果保证列方向最终出现素数，但高度仍为 P^5 或 P^4.5 量级，不能进入 P^2 方阵；Li-Zhang-Cai 的 P2 almost-prime 结果进入 P^2，却正好是错误奇偶对象。Guth--Maynard v2 与 Le Duc Hieu v2 在 theta>17/30 短区间内给出点态 PNT/等差数列结构，但换算到行尺度仍需要 P^(2/15+o(1)) 个行厚度。Stadlmann/Runbo Li/Pascadi 的大模数 AP 平均分布越过 x^1/2 甚至达到加权 5/8-o(1)，但不能转成固定素模数 P 的全 residue 列闭合；Bruna 2026 在广义 Lindelof 下得到 q^(2+epsilon) 条件近门槛，仍有条件性与 epsilon 超方阵误差。故所有有帮助的外部定理都已定位为 side bounds/parity diagnostics；目标命题仍需要 theta<=1/2 的点态短区间定理、Linnik<=2 的同窗口常数版本、theta=1/2 二阶矩到行格点的转移，或真正非线性破奇偶构造。

rows.payload: Every large interval of length x^0.525 contains a prime.
rows.transformed_payload: For x~P^2 this forbids prime-free row runs longer than P^0.05 up to constants.
rows.helps: Closes a genuine side theorem: no asymptotically long consecutive empty-row block of exponent >0.05.
rows.obstruction: Target row theorem needs theta<=1/2, i.e. empty-run exponent <0.

rows.payload: Claims every large interval of length x^0.52 contains a prime.
rows.transformed_payload: If accepted, this improves the empty-row run exponent bound from 0.05 to 0.04.
rows.helps: Best known-looking pointwise short-interval candidate located in this audit.
rows.obstruction: Still has theta=0.52>1/2 and is preprint status; it does not give one prime in each P-long row.

rows.payload: Uniform short-interval PNT at exponents theta>17/30.
rows.transformed_payload: For x~P^2 this gives row windows of size P^(17/15+o(1)), weaker than BHP/Li for pointwise row closure.
rows.helps: Important for zero-density and exceptional-set technology, but not the pointwise row gate.
rows.obstruction: 17/30>1/2; pointwise length is still too long.

rows.payload: Relates zero-density estimates to exceptional sets; records all-x theta>17/30 and almost-all theta>2/15 context.
rows.transformed_payload: Almost-all x control does not imply control on the rigid lattice endpoints kP or P^2-row blocks.
rows.helps: Useful for density-style side bounds and for checking that row-grid control is the missing interface.
rows.obstruction: Needs lattice/grid transfer from continuous exceptional measure to every P-spaced row endpoint.

rows.theorem: Le Duc Hieu 2025 prime APs in short intervals
rows.payload: For theta>17/30, every sufficiently long interval [x,x+x^theta] contains many k-term APs of primes.
rows.transformed_payload: At x~P^2 the interval length remains P^(17/15+o(1)); it certifies rich prime structure only after thickening each row by P^(2/15+o(1)) rows.
rows.helps: Rules out the hope that adding Green-Tao/transference structure at the 17/30 scale alone closes the P-row theorem.
rows.obstruction: The row window is still wider than one P-row; structural abundance does not imply a prime in each individual row.

rows.payload: Least prime in a reduced residue class mod q is O(q^5.2).
rows.transformed_payload: For q=P this gives a column prime by height P^5.2, far beyond the P^2 square.
rows.helps: Confirms the AP route is real but much too weak for P x P column closure.
rows.obstruction: Column theorem needs Linnik exponent <=2 with compatible constants/window.

rows.payload: Improves the general Linnik exponent below 5.
rows.transformed_payload: For q=P this is still height P^(5-o(1)), not P^2.
rows.helps: Best general published direction found for least prime AP, still not target-compatible.

rows.payload: For moduli with bounded cubic part, least AP prime is O(q^4.5).
rows.transformed_payload: Prime modulus P is structurally compatible with bounded cubic part, but P^4.5 is still outside the P^2 square.
rows.helps: Stronger special-modulus AP side theorem; gives no column closure.
rows.obstruction: Exponent gap 2.5 above the needed L<=2 threshold.

rows.theorem: Li-Zhang-Cai 2021 least P2 almost-prime in AP
rows.payload: Least at-most-two-prime-factor number in a reduced residue class is O(q^1.8345).
rows.transformed_payload: For q=P this enters the P^2 square, but it is an almost-prime, not a prime.
rows.helps: Sharp parity-barrier diagnostic: the AP sieve reaches the square for P2, not for primes.
rows.obstruction: Wrong parity object; cannot replace column prime existence.

rows.payload: Primes are equidistributed on average to smooth moduli up to x^(1/2+1/40-epsilon).
rows.transformed_payload: At x=P^2 this reaches moduli up to P^(1.05-o(1)), but the prime modulus P is not a smooth-modulus average input.
rows.helps: Confirms that distribution beyond the square-root barrier is available only with averaging/smoothness structure.
rows.obstruction: Column closure needs the fixed prime modulus q=P and every reduced residue class, not an average over smooth q.

rows.payload: Constructs a prime-indicator minorant with distribution level 10/19 for APs to smooth moduli.
rows.transformed_payload: At x=P^2 the modulus range is P^(20/19), again an averaged smooth-modulus input rather than fixed q=P.
rows.helps: Useful as a lower-bound sieve diagnostic: genuine minorants exist past 1/2 only after smooth-modulus averaging.
rows.obstruction: The minorant does not certify a prime in each residue class for the single prime modulus P.

rows.payload: Primes and smooth numbers are equidistributed in APs to moduli up to x^(5/8-o(1)) with triply-well-factorable weights.
rows.transformed_payload: At x=P^2 this reaches P^(5/4-o(1)) in modulus range, far beyond P, but only in weighted mean-value form.
rows.helps: Marks the strongest recorded distribution-exponent technology in this audit.
rows.obstruction: Weighted mean values do not imply a zero-exception theorem for the fixed prime modulus P and all columns.

rows.payload: Mean-value theorems for primes with bilinear moduli up to x^(9/17) and trilinear moduli up to x^(17/32); almost-all q bounds for pi(x;q,a).
rows.transformed_payload: At x=P^2 the bilinear/trilinear ranges are P^(18/17) and P^(17/16), so q=P lies below range, but only inside structured averages.
rows.helps: Newest AP-distribution frontier found this round; it sharpens the column stress test but does not give a pointwise column theorem.
rows.obstruction: Average over moduli and factorization classes cannot be specialized to every prime P and every residue a without a new fixed-modulus transfer.

rows.theorem: Bruna 2026 conditional GLH least AP prime
rows.payload: Assuming generalized Lindelof for Dirichlet L-functions, the least prime p≡a mod q satisfies p <<_eps q^(2+eps).
rows.transformed_payload: For q=P this gives P^(2+eps), a conditional near-square bound but not a prime guaranteed inside the strict P^2 square.
rows.helps: Pins the conditional Linnik route almost exactly at the square barrier.
rows.obstruction: It is conditional and has an epsilon/logarithmic overshoot; unconditional target needs L<=2 with compatible constants/window.
